    Expected g-linear loss for over-prediction of a random outcome

    Source: R/gpl_loss.R
    exp_over_loss.Rd

    Expected g-linear loss for over-prediction of a random outcome

    Usage

    exp_over_loss(dg = function(y) 1, F)

    Arguments

    dg

    derivative of the increment function g.

    F

    predictive cdf of the outcome.

    Value

    A function of an allocation x giving the expected g-linear loss of over-predicting an outcome distributed according to F.

    Examples

    eol <- exp_over_loss(F = pnorm)
eol(0)
#> [1] 0.3989423
